fullText.simplified:
第10章、他会死的

    妈妈和妹妹进了高尔的房间，她们要把房间里的家具搬出去卖钱。
    床底的高尔看到妈妈和妹妹，马上就哭了，但他还是不敢发出声音，他只能安静地哭。妹妹和妈妈开始搬房间里的家具。她们把东西一件件搬出去。书桌上的小熊娃娃掉到地上了。娃娃看着床底的高尔，好像又要说话了。高尔知道娃娃想说什么，他不敢看娃娃。
    妈妈也看到了娃娃，她去拿地上的娃娃。就在这时候，她看了看床底。床底很黑，但她好像在那儿看到了高尔。她被吓到了，大叫一声，晕倒在了地上。
    妹妹从外面跑进来，看了一眼就明白了。她马上跑去另一个房间，她去找妈妈的药。高尔也吓坏了，妈妈要马上吃药，他知道妈妈的药放在哪儿。他着急地从床底爬出来，想帮妹妹一起找药。但这时候，妹妹已经拿到药跑回来了。
    妹妹看到了高尔，清清楚楚地看到了高尔。妹妹也被吓到了，手里的药掉在了地上。她害怕地大叫：“天啊！我的天啊！”她一边叫着，一边想要退到房间外面去。
    “怎么了？”这是爸爸的声音，爸爸回来了。
    爸爸走到门口，先看到害怕的妹妹，再看到晕倒的妈妈和掉在地上的药，最后看到了药旁边的大甲虫高尔。爸爸明白了，他知道发生什么了。他的脸红了，他生气极了！
    高尔想要解释，但是他只能发出甲虫“嗯嗯”的叫声。
    爸爸看了看身后，他想找他的手杖，但没有找到。桌子上有几个苹果。他几步走过去，拿起一个苹果，用力向房间里的高尔扔了过来。他扔得又快又大力，一点儿都不像一个大事小事都需要人照顾的老人。
    苹果重重地打在了高尔的背上，高尔疼得大叫。爸爸拿起另一个苹果，又扔了过来，这一次打在了高尔的头上，高尔疼得大哭。
    爸爸又拿起一个苹果。这时候，妈妈醒了。她没有看高尔，但她哭着说：“别扔了，他会死的！”
    他会死的——是的，高尔觉得自己快死了，他疼得晕了过去。
fullText.traditional:
第10章、他會死的

    媽媽和妹妹進了高爾的房間，她們要把房間裡的家具搬出去賣錢。
    床底的高爾看到媽媽和妹妹，馬上就哭了，但他還是不敢發出聲音，他只能安靜地哭。妹妹和媽媽開始搬房間裡的家具。她們把東西一件件搬出去。書桌上的小熊娃娃掉到地上了。娃娃看著床底的高爾，好像又要說話了。高爾知道娃娃想說什麼，他不敢看娃娃。
    媽媽也看到了娃娃，她去拿地上的娃娃。就在這時候，她看了看床底。床底很黑，但她好像在那兒看到了高爾。她被嚇到了，大叫一聲，暈倒在了地上。
    妹妹從外面跑進來，看了一眼就明白了。她馬上跑去另一個房間，她去找媽媽的藥。高爾也嚇壞了，媽媽要馬上吃藥，他知道媽媽的藥放在哪兒。他著急地從床底爬出來，想幫妹妹一起找藥。但這時候，妹妹已經拿到藥跑回來了。
    妹妹看到了高爾，清清楚楚地看到了高爾。妹妹也被嚇到了，手裡的藥掉在了地上。她害怕地大叫：“天啊！我的天啊！”她一邊叫著，一邊想要退到房間外面去。
    “怎麼了？”這是爸爸的聲音，爸爸回來了。
    爸爸走到門口，先看到害怕的妹妹，再看到暈倒的媽媽和掉在地上的藥，最後看到了藥旁邊的大甲蟲高爾。爸爸明白了，他知道發生什麼了。他的臉紅了，他生氣極了！
    高爾想要解釋，但是他只能發出甲蟲“嗯嗯”的叫聲。
    爸爸看了看身後，他想找他的手杖，但沒有找到。桌子上有幾個蘋果。他幾步走過去，拿起一個蘋果，用力向房間裡的高爾扔了過來。他扔得又快又大力，一點兒都不像一個大事小事都需要人照顧的老人。
    蘋果重重地打在了高爾的背上，高爾疼得大叫。爸爸拿起另一個蘋果，又扔了過來，這一次打在了高爾的頭上，高爾疼得大哭。
    爸爸又拿起一個蘋果。這時候，媽媽醒了。她沒有看高爾，但她哭著說：“別扔了，他會死的！”
    他會死的——是的，高爾覺得自己快死了，他疼得暈了過去。

sentences.simplified: 妈妈和妹妹进了高尔的房间，她们要把房间里的家具搬出去卖钱。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽和妹妹進了高爾的房間，她們要把房間裡的家具搬出去賣錢。

sentences.english: Gao Er’s mother and little sister went into his room. They wanted to move the furniture out of the room to sell for money.

sentences.simplified: 床底的高尔看到妈妈和妹妹，马上就哭了，
sentences.traditional: 床底的高爾看到媽媽和妹妹，馬上就哭了，
sentences.pinyin: chuáng dǐ de gāo ěr kàn dào mā ma hé mèi mei mǎ shàng jiù kū le
sentences.english: Gao Er, who was under the bed, saw his mother and little sister and immediately started crying.

sentences.simplified: 但他还是不敢发出声音，他只能安静地哭。
sentences.traditional: 但他還是不敢發出聲音，他只能安靜地哭。
sentences.pinyin: dàn tā hái shi bù gǎn fā chū shēng yīn tā zhǐ néng ān jìng de kū
sentences.english: However, he didn’t dare make a sound, so he could only cry quietly.

sentences.simplified: 妹妹和妈妈开始搬房间里的家具。
sentences.traditional: 妹妹和媽媽開始搬房間裡的家具。
sentences.pinyin: mèi mei hé mā ma kāi shǐ bān fáng jiān lǐ de jiā jù
sentences.english: His little sister and mother began to move the furniture in the room.

sentences.simplified: 她们把东西一件件搬出去。书桌上的小熊娃娃掉到地上了。
sentences.traditional: 她們把東西一件件搬出去。書桌上的小熊娃娃掉到地上了。
sentences.pinyin: tā men bǎ dōng xi yí jiàn jiàn bān chū qù shū zhuō shang de xiǎo xióng wá wá diào dào dì shang le
sentences.english: They moved things out one by one. The little teddy bear on the desk fell on the floor.

sentences.simplified: 娃娃看着床底的高尔，好像又要说话了。
sentences.traditional: 娃娃看著床底的高爾，好像又要說話了。
sentences.pinyin: wá wá kàn zhe chuáng dǐ de gāo ěr hǎo xiàng yòu yào shuō huà le
sentences.english: The teddy bear looked at Gao Er, who was under the bed, as if it was about to speak again.

sentences.simplified: 高尔知道娃娃想说什么，他不敢看娃娃。
sentences.traditional: 高爾知道娃娃想說什麼，他不敢看娃娃。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr zhī dào wá wá xiǎng shuō shén me tā bù gǎn kàn wá wá
sentences.english: Gao Er knew what the teddy bear wanted to say, but he was too scared to look at the teddy bear.

sentences.simplified: 妈妈也看到了娃娃，她去拿地上的娃娃。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽也看到了娃娃，她去拿地上的娃娃。
sentences.pinyin: mā ma yě kàn dào le wá wá tā qù ná dì shang de wá wá
sentences.english: His mother also saw the teddy bear. She went to pick up the teddy bear on the floor.

sentences.simplified: 就在这时候，她看了看床底。床底很黑，但她好像在那儿看到了高尔。
sentences.traditional: 就在這時候，她看了看床底。床底很黑，但她好像在那兒看到了高爾。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zài zhè shí hou tā kàn le kàn chuáng dǐ chuáng dǐ hěn hēi dàn tā hǎo xiàng zài nà'r kàn dào le gāo ěr
sentences.english: Just then, she looked under the bed. It was very dark under the bed, but it seemed like she saw Gao Er there.

sentences.simplified: 她被吓到了，大叫一声，晕倒在了地上。
sentences.traditional: 她被嚇到了，大叫一聲，暈倒在了地上。
sentences.pinyin: tā bèi xià dào le dà jiào yì shēng yūn dǎo zài le dì shang
sentences.english: She was frightened and let out a scream, then fainted to the ground.

sentences.simplified: 妹妹从外面跑进来，看了一眼就明白了。
sentences.traditional: 妹妹從外面跑進來，看了一眼就明白了。
sentences.pinyin: mèi mei cóng wài miàn pǎo jìn lái kàn le yì yǎn jiù míng bai le
sentences.english: The little sister ran in from outside, took one look, and understood immediately.

sentences.simplified: 她马上跑去另一个房间，她去找妈妈的药。
sentences.traditional: 她馬上跑去另一個房間，她去找媽媽的藥。
sentences.pinyin: tā mǎ shàng pǎo qù lìng yí ge fáng jiān tā qù zhǎo mā ma de yào
sentences.english: She immediately ran to another room to look for her mother’s medicine.

sentences.simplified: 高尔也吓坏了，妈妈要马上吃药，他知道妈妈的药放在哪儿。
sentences.traditional: 高爾也嚇壞了，媽媽要馬上吃藥，他知道媽媽的藥放在哪兒。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr yě xià huài le mā ma yào mǎ shàng chī yào tā zhī dào mā ma de yào fàng zài nǎ'r
sentences.english: Gao Er was also scared. His mother needed to take her medicine immediately, and he knew where her medicine was.

sentences.simplified: 他着急地从床底爬出来，想帮妹妹一起找药。
sentences.traditional: 他著急地從床底爬出來，想幫妹妹一起找藥。
sentences.pinyin: tā zháo jí de cóng chuáng dǐ pá chu lai xiǎng bāng mèi mei yì qǐ zhǎo yào
sentences.english: He crawled out from under the bed anxiously, wanting to help his little sister find the medicine.

sentences.simplified: 但这时候，妹妹已经拿到药跑回来了。
sentences.traditional: 但這時候，妹妹已經拿到藥跑回來了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn zhè shí hou mèi mei yǐ jīng ná dào yào pǎo huí lai le
sentences.english: But at that moment, his little sister had already gotten the medicine and run back.

sentences.simplified: 妹妹看到了高尔，清清楚楚地看到了高尔。
sentences.traditional: 妹妹看到了高爾，清清楚楚地看到了高爾。
sentences.pinyin: mèi mei kàn dào le gāo ěr qīng qīng chu chu de kàn dào le gāo ěr
sentences.english: Gao Er’s little sister saw him. She saw him very clearly.

sentences.simplified: 妹妹也被吓到了，手里的药掉在了地上。
sentences.traditional: 妹妹也被嚇到了，手裡的藥掉在了地上。
sentences.pinyin: mèi mei yě bèi xià dào le shǒu lǐ de yào diào zài le dì shang
sentences.english: His little sister was also frightened, and the medicine in her hand fell on the floor.

sentences.simplified: 她害怕地大叫：“天啊！我的天啊！”
sentences.traditional: 她害怕地大叫：“天啊！我的天啊！”
sentences.pinyin: tā hài pà de dà jiào tiān ā wǒ de tiān a
sentences.english: She screamed in fear, “God! Oh my god!”

sentences.simplified: 她一边叫着，一边想要退到房间外面去。
sentences.traditional: 她一邊叫著，一邊想要退到房間外面去。
sentences.pinyin: tā yì biān jiào zhe yì biān xiǎng yào tuì dào fáng jiān wài miàn qù
sentences.english: She shouted while also retreating to outside the room.

sentences.simplified: “怎么了？”这是爸爸的声音，爸爸回来了。
sentences.traditional: “怎麼了？”這是爸爸的聲音，爸爸回來了。
sentences.pinyin: zěn me le zhè shì bà ba de shēng yīn bà ba huí lái le
sentences.english: “What’s wrong?” This was Gao Er’s father’s voice. His father was back.

sentences.simplified: 爸爸走到门口，
sentences.traditional: 爸爸走到門口，
sentences.pinyin: bà ba zǒu dào mén kǒu
sentences.english: His father walked to the door.

sentences.simplified: 先看到害怕的妹妹，再看到晕倒的妈妈和掉在地上的药，
sentences.traditional: 先看到害怕的妹妹，再看到暈倒的媽媽和掉在地上的藥，
sentences.pinyin: xiān kàn dào hài pà de mèi mei zài kàn dào yūn dǎo de mā ma hé diào zài dì shang de yào
sentences.english: He first saw the scared little sister, and then he saw Gao Er’s mother who had fainted and the medicine that had fallen on the ground.

sentences.simplified: 最后看到了药旁边的大甲虫高尔。
sentences.traditional: 最後看到了藥旁邊的大甲蟲高爾。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu kàn dào le yào páng biān de dà jiǎ chóng gāo ěr
sentences.english: Finally, he saw the large beetle Gao Er next to the medicine.

sentences.simplified: 爸爸明白了，他知道发生什么了。他的脸红了，他生气极了！
sentences.traditional: 爸爸明白了，他知道發生什麼了。他的臉紅了，他生氣極了！
sentences.pinyin: bà ba míng bai le tā zhī dào fā shēng shén me le tā de liǎn hóng le tā shēng qì jí le
sentences.english: His father understood. He knew what had happened. His face turned red. He was extremely angry!

sentences.simplified: 高尔想要解释，但是他只能发出甲虫“嗯嗯”的叫声。
sentences.traditional: 高爾想要解釋，但是他只能發出甲蟲“嗯嗯”的叫聲。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr xiǎng yào jiě shì dàn shì tā zhǐ néng fā chū jiǎ chóng ēn ēn de jiào shēng
sentences.english: Gao Er wanted to explain, but all he could make was a “hmm hmm” sound like a beetle.

sentences.simplified: 爸爸看了看身后，他想找他的手杖，但没有找到。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸看了看身後，他想找他的手杖，但沒有找到。
sentences.pinyin: bà ba kàn le kàn shēn hòu tā xiǎng zhǎo tā de shǒu zhàng dàn méi yǒu zhǎo dào
sentences.english: His father looked behind him. He wanted to find his cane, but he couldn’t find it.

sentences.simplified: 桌子上有几个苹果。
sentences.traditional: 桌子上有幾個蘋果。
sentences.pinyin: zhuō zi shang yǒu jǐ ge píng guǒ
sentences.english: There were several apples on the table.

sentences.simplified: 他几步走过去，拿起一个苹果，用力向房间里的高尔扔了过来。
sentences.traditional: 他幾步走過去，拿起一個蘋果，用力向房間裡的高爾扔了過來。
sentences.pinyin: tā jǐ bù zǒu guò qu ná qǐ yí ge píng guǒ yòng lì xiàng fáng jiān lǐ de gāo ěr rēng le guò lái
sentences.english: He took a few steps forward, picked up an apple, and threw it hard at Gao Er in the room.

sentences.simplified: 他扔得又快又大力，一点儿都不像一个大事小事都需要人照顾的老人。
sentences.traditional: 他扔得又快又大力，一點兒都不像一個大事小事都需要人照顧的老人。
sentences.pinyin: tā rēng de yòu kuài yòu dà lì yì diǎn'r dōu bú xiàng yí ge dà shì xiǎo shì dōu xū yào rén zhào gù de lǎo rén
sentences.english: He threw it quickly and forcefully, not at all like an old man who needed help with everything, big or small.

sentences.simplified: 苹果重重地打在了高尔的背上，高尔疼得大叫。
sentences.traditional: 蘋果重重地打在了高爾的背上，高爾疼得大叫。
sentences.pinyin: píng guǒ zhòng zhòng de dǎ zài le gāo ěr de bèi shang gāo ěr téng de dà jiào
sentences.english: The apple hit Gao Er’s back very heavily. Gao Er screamed in pain.

sentences.simplified: 爸爸拿起另一个苹果，又扔了过来，这一次打在了高尔的头上，
sentences.traditional: 爸爸拿起另一個蘋果，又扔了過來，這一次打在了高爾的頭上，
sentences.pinyin: bà ba ná qǐ lìng yí ge píng guǒ yòu rēng le guò lái zhè yí cì dǎ zài le gāo ěr de tóu shang
sentences.english: His father picked up another apple and threw it again, this time hitting Gao Er on the head.

sentences.simplified: 高尔疼得大哭。
sentences.traditional: 高爾疼得大哭。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr téng de dà kū
sentences.english: Gao Er cried loudly in pain.

sentences.simplified: 爸爸又拿起一个苹果。这时候，妈妈醒了。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸又拿起一個蘋果。這時候，媽媽醒了。
sentences.pinyin: bà ba yòu ná qǐ yí ge píng guǒ zhè shí hou mā ma xǐng le
sentences.english: His father picked up another apple. At that moment, his mother woke up.

sentences.simplified: 她没有看高尔，但她哭着说：“别扔了，他会死的！”

sentences.english: She didn’t look at Gao Er, but she sobbed, “Stop throwing them; he will die!”

sentences.simplified: 他会死的——是的，高尔觉得自己快死了，他疼得晕了过去。
sentences.traditional: 他會死的——是的，高爾覺得自己快死了，他疼得暈了過去。
sentences.pinyin: tā huì sǐ de shì de gāo ěr jué de zì jǐ kuài sǐ le tā téng de yūn le guò qù
sentences.english: He will die—yes, Gao Er felt like he was about to die. He was in so much pain he fainted.

sentence_translations: Chapter 10: He Will Die
Gao Er’s mother and little sister went into his room. They wanted to move the furniture out of the room to sell for money.
Gao Er, who was under the bed, saw his mother and little sister and immediately started crying.
However, he didn’t dare make a sound, so he could only cry quietly.
His little sister and mother began to move the furniture in the room.
They moved things out one by one. The little teddy bear on the desk fell on the floor.
The teddy bear looked at Gao Er, who was under the bed, as if it was about to speak again.
Gao Er knew what the teddy bear wanted to say, but he was too scared to look at the teddy bear.
His mother also saw the teddy bear. She went to pick up the teddy bear on the floor.
Just then, she looked under the bed. It was very dark under the bed, but it seemed like she saw Gao Er there.
She was frightened and let out a scream, then fainted to the ground.
The little sister ran in from outside, took one look, and understood immediately.
She immediately ran to another room to look for her mother’s medicine.
Gao Er was also scared. His mother needed to take her medicine immediately, and he knew where her medicine was.
He crawled out from under the bed anxiously, wanting to help his little sister find the medicine.
But at that moment, his little sister had already gotten the medicine and run back.
Gao Er’s little sister saw him. She saw him very clearly.
His little sister was also frightened, and the medicine in her hand fell on the floor.
She screamed in fear, “God! Oh my god!”
She shouted while also retreating to outside the room.
“What’s wrong?” This was Gao Er’s father’s voice. His father was back.
His father walked to the door.
He first saw the scared little sister, and then he saw Gao Er’s mother who had fainted and the medicine that had fallen on the ground.
Finally, he saw the large beetle Gao Er next to the medicine.
His father understood. He knew what had happened. His face turned red. He was extremely angry!
Gao Er wanted to explain, but all he could make was a “hmm hmm” sound like a beetle.
His father looked behind him. He wanted to find his cane, but he couldn’t find it.
There were several apples on the table.
He took a few steps forward, picked up an apple, and threw it hard at Gao Er in the room.
He threw it quickly and forcefully, not at all like an old man who needed help with everything, big or small.
The apple hit Gao Er’s back very heavily. Gao Er screamed in pain.
His father picked up another apple and threw it again, this time hitting Gao Er on the head.
Gao Er cried loudly in pain.
His father picked up another apple. At that moment, his mother woke up.
She didn’t look at Gao Er, but she sobbed, “Stop throwing them; he will die!”
He will die—yes, Gao Er felt like he was about to die. He was in so much pain he fainted.
